name: dsh-usage-stats
description: Usage statistics for the DSH web GUI: a settings page (用量统计) with a token-usage heatmap (GitHub-style calendar, wrapped to fit), a 24-hour token bar chart, per-model token breakdown, and whole-history totals. Aggregates every session's durable log (assistant/message usage events) on the host and serves read-only /api/dsh-usage-stats/* routes. Mounted as a permanent bundle patch without dsh source changes.
